title: Career roadmap · Business Development Executive
summary: A Business Development Executive identifies prospects, builds business relationships, generates qualified leads, presents solutions, negotiates opportunities, and supports revenue growth.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a standard 3-year BBA/BMS/BBM. If a 4-year honours/research variant is available, use the additional year for advanced sales analytics, internships, industry projects, and a major business-development project.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Business Development Executive is directly aligned with the BBA General pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build business fundamentals, communication, sales, CRM, market research and negotiation skills; complete internships and measurable sales projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in B2B sales, SaaS sales, enterprise business development, partnerships, international sales, recruitment/business services or fintech sales.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior BDE, Business Development Manager, Account Manager, Key Account Manager or Partnerships Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine commercial strategy, customer analytics, AI-assisted prospecting, account management, negotiation and sales leadership.

Career progression
Alternative route:
Progression depends on sales performance, industry, company structure and leadership responsibilities.
PhD routes
If pursuing research or academia, relevant areas include:
A PhD is generally more relevant to research, teaching and specialised strategy roles than to entry-level business development.

The long-term goal should be to progress from individual sales execution to revenue strategy and commercial leadership. AI can increasingly assist with prospect research, lead scoring, outreach and CRM automation, so senior professionals should focus on complex negotiations, strategic accounts, partnerships, customer economics, market positioning and team leadership.
